text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After seizing 1st place in the Hakodate 
Sprint Stakes, K.S. Miracle was sound 
asleep in the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, her demeanor was far too quiet. 
Growing increasingly concerned, the 
Trainer realized that what she truly 
needed was rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To allow plenty of time before her next 
race, the target was set for the Keeneland 
Cup, two months away.
